maskConvention.bit0: bottom screen corner / world SE vertex
maskConvention.bit1: left screen corner / world SW vertex
maskConvention.bit2: right screen corner / world NE vertex
maskConvention.bit3: top screen corner / world NW vertex
maskConvention.bitSetMeaning: that diamond corner resolves to grass
maskConvention.sourceMaskMeaning: vendor cell index used directly as the grass-corner mask; no polarity conversion or mirroring

sourceGrid.label: bottom + left + right / SE + SW + NE
bottom + left + top / SE + SW + NW
bottom + right + top / SE + NE + NW
left + right + top / SW + NE + NW

vertexResolution.sharedCells: A vertex at (row,column) reads the four cells [row-1,column-1], [row-1,column], [row,column-1], [row,column].
vertexResolution.mixedMaterials: Choose the highest-priority in-bounds family: water > soil > path > grass.
vertexResolution.mapBoundary: Ignore out-of-bounds cells; if no in-bounds cell exists, resolve the vertex as grass. This prevents an artificial grass border around a solid map-edge region.
vertexResolution.tileSelection: For a grass center, choose the highest-priority non-grass family present at its resolved vertices and use the direct grass-corner mask. A non-grass center uses its family mask 0 hard-edge tile.
vertexResolution.grassLocalization: Soil-derived grass owns open Farm ground; path- and water-derived grass appears only in its own transition boundary.

checkerboardTieBreak: Cells 6 and 9 are valid opposite-corner checkerboards under the direct corner mask. Equal-priority mixed vertices use the fixed order water, soil, path, grass; no sheet order, XOR, flipping, or mirroring is used.
